name: k1-brass-anchor
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__game,c=g.ctx;const r=c.state.communities.portage.rafts.get('anchor');const V=c.player.position.constructor;const up=c.player.update.bind(c.player);let hold=null;c.player.update=(dt)=>{up(dt);if(hold){c.player.position.copy(hold);c.player.velocity.set(0,0,0);c.player.mode='foot';}};for(let i=0;i<40;i++){const p=new V(-3,1.0,7.5).applyMatrix4(r.root.matrixWorld);hold=p;c.player.teleport(p);c.player.yaw=r.root.rotation.y+-0.25;c.player.pitch=0.12;g.step(1);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,0));}})()

name: k2-club-bar
eval: (async()=>{const g=window.__game,c=g.ctx,cl=c.club;for(const f of ['lamp_map','has_pin','coded_lamp']) c.story.setFlag(f);cl.enter();cl.state.admitted=true;const V=c.player.position.constructor;const up=c.player.update.bind(c.player);let hold=null,hm='foot';c.player.update=(dt)=>{up(dt);if(hold){c.player.position.copy(hold);c.player.velocity.set(0,0,0);c.player.mode=hm;}};for(let i=0;i<60;i++){const p=new V(11,0,1.2).add(cl.origin);hold=p;hm='foot';c.player.teleport(p);c.player.yaw=1.75;c.player.pitch=-0.04;g.step(1);await new Promise(q=>setTimeout(q,0));}})()

name: k3-club-stage
